extraction.tier_rationale: Canonical rocuronium PK model, but the primary-source compartmental parameters are not openly reproduced consistently across secondary sources; pending field-by-field transcription.

Curated record with verified citation; KERNEL PENDING. simulate() refuses this model rather than ship compartmental parameters that cannot be reconciled to the primary PDF. Seeds the nmb_agents subsystem; pairs with the train-of-four PD sigmoid once a verified PK kernel lands.

source_review.reviewed_by: automated source cross-check (Claude Opus 4.8 via Hypnos research agents)
source_review.method: fetched FDA/EMA labels (DailyMed/SmPC), primary-paper PubMed abstracts, open implementations, and CrossRef, then compared each curated value against the fetched values
sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opentiva/opentiva/master/opentiva/rocuronium.py (Wierda class: V1 0.044*wt, k10 0.1, k12 0.21, k13 0.028, k21 0.13, k31 0.01)
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/1829656/ (Wierda 1991 abstract: Vdss 0.264 L/kg, Cl 4.0 mL/kg/min, t1/2 1.8/19/131 min)
source_review.notes: Source-filled the two curated params from the opentiva Wierda implementation: V1 = 0.044*WGT (~3.08 L at 70 kg) and ke0 ~0.1/min (the ke0 formula is attributed to Masui 2018, not the original Wierda paper). The full 3-compartment micro-rate set (k10 0.1, k12 0.21, k13 0.028, k21 0.13, k31 0.01) and the original-paper aggregates (Vdss 0.264 L/kg, Cl 4.0 mL/kg/min) are recorded here for the human verifier. CITATION: the record's DOI was objectively wrong (BF03007580 -> a scopolamine paper); fixed to BF03007578 (CrossRef-verified). KERNEL STILL PENDING — values pending human confirmation + a wired kernel before simulation. Original PMID may also need a check (abstract found at PMID 1829656).
